hero.headline: Rediscover Serenity in Pure Nature
hero.subheadline: A transformative wellness immersion nestled between ancient cliffs and tranquil waters, blending time-honored Vietnamese herbal therapies, mindful yoga, and bespoke organic cuisine.

philosophy.title: The Art of Silence & Deep Restoration
philosophy.paragraph1: Nestled in an untouched national biosphere reserve embracing a secluded marine bay, HeavenStay was conceived as an unhurried haven where modern pace surrenders to the cadence of the tides and forest breezes.
philosophy.paragraph2: We believe authentic vitality begins when the body is deeply rested, the mind unburdened, and intrinsic energy rekindled through bespoke, attentive care.

restore.title: Restore
restore.desc: Purify and decompress through mineral hydrotherapy, herbal poultice acupressure, and time-honored Eastern bodywork.

reconnect.title: Reconnect
reconnect.desc: Quiet the wandering mind in silence alongside master instructors, breathwork meditation, and Tibetan singing bowl resonance.

nourish.title: Nourish
nourish.desc: Wholesome culinary creations crafted from local organic micro-farms, calibrated to your metabolic requirements and allergies.

showcase.title: Curated Holistic Immersions
showcase.subtitle: Each multi-day journey is individually tuned to your wellness objectives, from brief restorative escapes to profound life resets.

spa.title: Bespoke Herbal Therapy
spa.desc: Private pavilion treatment rooms overlooking the ocean, guided by master practitioners using proprietary botanical elixirs.

yoga.title: Dawn Yoga & Mindfulness
yoga.desc: Greet the morning over cliffside open-air pavilions, practicing mindful vinyasa flow and pranayama breathing.

dining.title: Farm-to-Table Gastronomy
dining.desc: Every dish is tailored to your verified dietary preferences, honoring organic produce and culinary refinement.

villas.title: Secluded Pavilions Sheltered by Earth & Stone
villas.desc: Minimalist architecture sculpted from native timber, granite, and coastal breezes. Each freestanding villa features a private heated mineral pool and tranquil meditation deck.
features: Panoramic views of protected national bay and jungle canopy

resonance.title: Echoes of Transformation
resonance.quote1: “Three days at HeavenStay restored the deep, restorative sleep I hadn't experienced in years. Every detail—from herbal infusions to sunset sound baths—was flawless.”
resonance.author1: Eleanor Vance — Mindful Renewal Retreat Customer
resonance.quote2: “Complete seclusion, therapists with deep intuitive knowledge, and cuisine that feels like medicine for the soul. Truly an extraordinary sanctuary.”
resonance.author2: Jonathan Vance — Complete Reset Retreat Customer

cta.title: Begin Your Personal Restoration
cta.desc: Let HeavenStay guide your return to balance, vitality, and enduring inner peace.
